card.architecture: Krea 2 Turbo — 8-step distilled of Krea 2 RAW (Qwen3-VL 4B encoder, Qwen-Image/Wan2.1 VAE); fp8 (bf16 is 26 GB), run on an 8 GB GPU with the weights offloaded to system RAM
card.summary: Distilled few-step (8-step) version of Krea 2 with the same polished aesthetic at a fraction of the cost. Runs without CFG (guidance 0 / cfg 1), so no negative prompts. fp8 weight spilled to system RAM on an 8 GB GPU; pick this over RAW when you want Krea's look fast.
use_cases: photographic and editorial looks at speed
card.commercial_use: open weights — verify the Krea 2 license for your use
card.pick_when: You want Krea 2's polished aesthetic fast (8 steps) and don't need negative prompts; runs on an 8 GB GPU (fp8 + RAM offload).

prompt.guidance: Descriptive natural-language prose; aesthetic/style words carry weight.
prompt.example: an editorial photograph of a ceramic vase on a sunlit table, soft film grain, muted earth tones, shallow depth of field
prompt.instructions: Write natural language; lean into style, lighting, and mood descriptors. Distilled turbo: 8 steps, no CFG (guidance 0 / cfg 1), euler/simple. Native ~1K (up to 2K). No negative prompts (cfg 1).
do: Keep it to 8 steps — more won't help
prompt.negative_guidance: Not supported (distilled, cfg 1); describe what you want.

negative.note: Distilled few-step (cfg 1 / guidance 0); negatives don't work.

speed.note: 12B-class fp8 but only 8 steps; the fp8 encoder offloads before the diffusion model loads.
speed.measured_note: Not yet benchmarked on this box.

ui_help.note: Describe what you want in plain words; style and lighting words matter most. This is the fast (8-step) Krea — use it for quick aesthetic results.
